description: Umbrella PRD for initiative 3: CSV exports, Word export, eval harness, and demo repeatability controls.

userStories.title: CSV exports for 3 artefacts
userStories.description: Export requirements, exceptions, and survey issues to stable CSVs with citations and statuses.
acceptanceCriteria: One-click exports produce requirements_tracker.csv, exceptions_table.csv, and survey_issues.csv.
Each row includes citation references (doc name + page) and row status.
Column ordering is stable across runs and packs.
If any rows are excluded due to citation_failed, show a warning banner with counts.

userStories.title: Word export (single template)
userStories.description: Generate a single .docx artefact from report rows using a fixed memo template.
acceptanceCriteria: Export produces a .docx with deal snapshot, requirements, exceptions (with citations), and survey issues.
Rows with citation_failed are excluded and a warning banner explains what was removed.
Template is fixed and stored in the repo (memo).

userStories.title: Golden-set eval harness
userStories.description: Run a lightweight eval against /truth to detect regressions in output quality.
acceptanceCriteria: Eval runner outputs coverage, citation validity rate, and missing_input correctness per pack.
Harness compares outputs against /truth and emits JSON + markdown summary.
CI runs the harness in report-only mode and stores the artifact.

userStories.title: Demo reliability controls
userStories.description: Provide demo mode, pack selector, and safe reset so demos can be repeated.
acceptanceCriteria: Demo mode can load pack_01_clean and pack_02_missing_rea and run Quick Start or pre-seeded rows.
Reset tool removes only demo matters and requires explicit confirmation.
A demo checklist exists in the repo.
